pages.title: Tuning Fork
pages.text: Strike it against a machine with a console and it rings at the machine's own pitch. Then the machine has to be calibrated by hand, with a short game that fits its science: match a waveform, line up a spectrum, route a flow, balance an equation, chain a proof or sieve primes.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Resonant Tuning Fork.
